mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gru_record_export_intent(project_id,export_id,conversation_id,owner_id,conversation_revision,document_id,document_revision,scope_snapshot_id,canonical_request,request_body_sha256,operation_request_sha256,operation_id,idempotency_key,session_id,context_json,basis_json,message_manifest_json,message_manifest_sha256,message_count,canonical_content,content_sha256,size_bytes,write_intent_json,artifact_id,dependency_access_set_id,dependency_manifest_sha256,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,deadline,classification) SELECT #{row.projectId},#{row.exportId},#{row.conversationId},#{row.ownerId},#{row.conversationRevision},#{row.documentId},#{row.documentRevision},#{row.snapshotId},#{row.canonicalRequest},#{row.requestBodySha256},#{row.operationRequestSha256},#{row.operationId},#{row.idempotencyKey},#{row.sessionId},#{row.contextJson},#{row.basisJson},#{row.messageManifestJson},#{row.messageManifestSha256},#{row.messageCount},#{row.canonicalContent},#{row.contentSha256},#{row.sizeBytes},#{row.writeIntentJson},#{row.artifactId},#{row.accessSetId},#{row.dependencyManifestSha256},#{row.schemaVersion},#{row.schemaManifest},#{row.createdBy},#{row.createdAt},#{row.deadline},#{row.classification} FROM conversation c JOIN gru_conversation_context g ON g.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND g.project_id=c.project_id AND g.conversation_id=c.conversation_id JOIN operation_record o ON o.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND o.operation_id=#{row.operationId} WHERE c.project_id=#{row.projectId} AND c.conversation_id=#{row.conversationId} AND c.owner_id=#{userId} AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.revision=#{row.conversationRevision} AND g.document_id=#{row.documentId} AND g.document_revision=#{row.documentRevision} AND g.scope_snapshot_id=#{row.snapshotId} AND #{row.ownerId}=#{userId} AND #{row.createdBy}=#{userId} AND o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.created_by=#{userId} AND o.operation_name='GRU-RECORD-EXPORT' AND o.idempotency_key=#{row.idempotencyKey} AND o.target_id=#{row.exportId} AND o.request_sha256=#{row.operationRequestSha256} AND o.state='PROCESSING' AND o.revision=1 AND o.created_at=#{row.createdAt} AND o.schema_manifest_sha256=#{row.schemaManifest} AND o.classification=#{row.classification}

INSERT INTO gru_record_export(project_id,export_id,operation_id,artifact_id,dependency_access_set_id,dependency_manifest_sha256,object_reference,content_sha256,size_bytes,receipt_json,audit_event_id,outbox_event_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification) SELECT #{row.projectId},#{row.exportId},#{row.operationId},#{row.artifactId},#{row.accessSetId},#{row.dependencyManifestSha256},#{row.objectReference},#{row.contentSha256},#{row.sizeBytes},#{row.receiptJson},#{row.auditEventId},#{row.outboxEventId},#{row.schemaVersion},#{row.schemaManifest},#{row.createdBy},#{row.createdAt},#{row.classification} FROM gru_record_export_intent i JOIN gru_record_export_attempt t ON t.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND t.project_id=i.project_id AND t.export_id=i.export_id AND t.operation_id=i.operation_id JOIN artifact a ON a.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND a.project_id=i.project_id AND a.artifact_id=i.artifact_id WHERE i.project_id=#{row.projectId} AND i.export_id=#{row.exportId} AND i.operation_id=#{row.operationId} AND i.owner_id=#{userId} AND i.created_by=#{userId} AND t.created_by=#{userId} AND t.schema_version=i.schema_version AND t.schema_manifest_sha256=i.schema_manifest_sha256 AND t.classification=i.classification AND t.created_at=t.attempted_at AND #{row.createdBy}=#{userId} AND i.artifact_id=#{row.artifactId} AND i.dependency_access_set_id=#{row.accessSetId} AND i.dependency_manifest_sha256=#{row.dependencyManifestSha256} AND i.content_sha256=#{row.contentSha256} AND i.size_bytes=#{row.sizeBytes} AND i.schema_manifest_sha256=#{row.schemaManifest} AND i.classification=#{row.classification} AND a.sha256=i.content_sha256 AND a.size_bytes=i.size_bytes AND a.dependency_access_set_id=i.dependency_access_set_id AND a.document_revision=i.document_revision AND a.run_id IS NULL AND a.artifact_kind='GRU_RECORD_EXPORT' AND a.created_by=#{userId} AND a.object_ref=CAST(#{row.objectReference} AS JSON)
